_meta.description: Ordered action-priority rules consumed by TurnPlanner. Rules are evaluated top-down; the first matching rule wins.

fields.priority: Evaluation order — lower number = higher priority
fields.action: Canonical action label returned in the action list
fields.condition: Human-readable trigger condition (evaluated by TurnPlanner logic)
fields.profile_tag: Which priority_profile strings activate this rule ('*' = always active)

rules.rationale: Perfect Sequencing: Always gather information (draw/search) before making board commitments like energy attachment.
Sniper Disruption: If the opponent just searched for a winning piece, instantly shuffle their hand to destroy their setup.
Always prioritize pulling up and KO'ing the opponent's draw engine (e.g., Bibarel, Baxcalibur) to cripple their setup.
Taking a KO advances prize count — highest tempo play available.
Retreating an injured Active Pokemon denies the opponent prizes and pivots to a fresh attacker.
Evolving unlocks higher-damage attacks and abilities on the next turn.
Energy attachment is once-per-turn; always use if available to build pressure.
Supporters provide draw or search; one allowed per turn — play before trainers that may shuffle hand.
Trainer cards provide draw, search, or disruption without spending the attack.
Benching basics preserves future evolution lines and prevents auto-loss from empty bench.
Fallback when no higher-priority action is legal this turn.

aggressive.description: Maximise damage output; skip trainer plays that don't accelerate KO.

defensive.description: Preserve resources; prioritise evolution and trainer cards.
